title: Panoramic Glass Roof
summary: Feedback about the G70 panoramic glass roof mixes clear appreciation for its appearance with a few specific defect complaints, while most sampled fragments are too brief or descriptive to determine sentiment confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise enjoyment and appearance of the glass or panoramic roof.

negative.summary: Negative reviews cite a diagnosed sunroof glass defect with trapped bubbles, and the other negative example is too brief to clarify the issue.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews include brief mentions, feature questions, and requests or complaints about heat, opening capability, cracks, sunshade performance, and reflective controls without enough context to classify overall sentiment reliably.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in characterizing overall sentiment.
Some examples are extremely brief or fragmentary, so the underlying roof or glass issue is not clear.
